a.title: Patients and families access their longitudinal care plan in clear, understandable formats. (Outcome)
Improved adherence to treatments and care transitions. (Outcome)
Higher patient satisfaction and trust in the health system. (Outcome)
Continuous feedback loops into care quality (patient-reported data integrated into clinical record). (Outcome)
Measurable equity and inclusion improvements in decision-making. (Outcome)
